article.title: Special provisions as to disposal of questions relating to constitutional validity of State laws
article.content:
228ASpecial provisions as to disposal of questions relating to constitutional validity of State laws

Article 228A · Part VI
Omitted by the Constitution (Forty-third Amendment) Act, 1977, s. 10 (w.e.f. 13-4-1978).

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976, s. 42 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
